name: rag-chatbot-project
description: RAG-Enhanced PDF Policy Chatbot with automatic cache clearing

scripts.install-all: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.cleanup: cd backend && python -c "import shutil, os; [shutil.rmtree(d) for d in ['./chroma_db', './temp', './tmp'] if os.path.exists(d)]; [os.remove(f) for f in ['token.pickle', 'drive_sync_state.json'] if os.path.exists(f)]; print('Cache cleaned manually')"
